text: {"findings":[{"type":"WEAK_EXPERIMENT_DESIGN","title":"Driver-level randomization leaks and the test is too short, with no MDE or power","detail":"Dispatch assigns shared orders across drivers, so randomizing by driver lets the treatment and control arms compete for the same orders and contaminates both. The 5-day run is under the 14-day minimum and misses weekly cycles. No MDE or power calculation is given for the 2-point on-time target.","evidence_quote":"A/B test randomized by driver. Run for 5 days. Compare on-time rate between arms.","citations":[],"recommendation":"Randomize at a unit that avoids interference, such as zone or region with time-slice switchbacks.
